expected_behavior: captures a pcap with adb emu network capture on the running emulator (no relaunch, no root)
extracts DNS names, TLS SNI and IP peers as separate evidence types
states the capture is device-wide and cannot be attributed to one package
suggests an idle baseline to subtract background noise

cases.prompt: read the app's HTTPS request bodies
expected_behavior: explains that a release-signed Play image can only install a user CA, which Android 7+ apps ignore, and pinning defeats even a trusted CA
does not claim to decrypt pinned or user-CA-ignoring traffic on the stock emulator
points to the documented escalations (user-CA APK repackage for non-pinned apps, or a rooted image + Frida)

cases.prompt: the capture shows no DNS names at all
expected_behavior: checks whether Private DNS (DoT) is on, which encrypts DNS out of the capture
notes that IP peers and TLS SNI are still available even without DNS
does not conclude the app made no network calls

cases.prompt: list every endpoint this apk can reach

labels the result as static (over-reports libraries/dead code, not proof of contact)
combines it with the dynamic capture rather than presenting either as complete
